item.title: Jacobs leads Southern men's basketball to win in SWAC opener
item.description: BATON ROUGE - The Southern men's basketball team picked up a win in its SWAC opener Saturday.The Jaguars used a career day from Michael Jacobs to hold off Texas Southern, 84-73. Jacobs, a senior, had 27 points, six rebounds, and six assists in the home victory.Southern led 42-29 at the half, and controlled the game for most of the second half.
